eps.ov: A young boy visits Mele the Horizon's Roar, while Kuuro the Cautious is on the run in Toghie City.
Kuuro the Cautious searches for a traitor. Elsewhere, Shirok the Sextant meets a beautiful girl.

eps.t: Toroa the Awful and Mestelexil the Box of Desperate Knowledge
eps.ov: Elgite the Ochre Haze sets out to steal enchanted swords while Mestelexil fights another golem.

eps.t: Atrazek the Particle Storm, Part One

eps.t: Atrazek the Particle Storm, Part Two
eps.ov: Toroa the Awful confronts Mestelexil the Box of Desperate Knowledge as the Particle Storm nears.
Jelki the Swift Ink grants Gilnes a chance to fight for justice in a duel.

eps.t: Lucnoca the Winter and Psianop the Inexhaustible Stagnation
eps.ov: Harghent the Still and Lagrex the Butchering Landslide seek a dragon. Elsewhere, an ooze appears.
Cunodey the Ring Seat, an oracle of the Religious Order, joins an expedition to hunt down an ogre.
Yukiharu the Twilight Diver encounters deadly mercenaries. At Okahu, a legendary gunner approaches.
Rique the Misfortune and Krafnir the Hatch of Truth attempt to find the Demon King's child.
Yukiharu is targeted by mercenaries and Hiroto the Paradox visits the leader of Okahu.
Twenty-one years ago, the First Party confronted the True Demon King. Why did they fail?
